questions.sampleA1: Yes. I like geography. It is good. Maps.
questions.sampleA2: Yes, I like geography. It is interesting because I learn about countries. I like to see the maps and the different places. I want to travel.

questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I've always had a bit of a soft spot for geography. I find it genuinely fascinating to learn how landscapes and people shape one another. The map-reading side can be a little dull, I suppose, but on the whole it's a subject I really look forward to studying.

questions.uzSampleB1:
Men geografiyani juda yoqtiraman. Menimcha, turli mamlakatlar va madaniyatlar haqida o'rganish qiziqarli.
Misol uchun, dunyoning turli qismlaridagi iqlim haqida o'rganish menga yoqadi.

Masalan, iqlim o'zgarishining sohil bo'yi jamoalariga ta'siri haqida bilish ham qiziqarli, ham muhim. Biroq, ba'zan xaritalar proyeksiyalari kabi texnik jihatlar biroz zerikarli tuyuladi. Shunga qaramay, geografiya global muammolarni tushunish uchun muhim asos yaratishini qadrlayman.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Do you like Geography?...

"The world is your oyster" - "Dunyo sizning istiridingiz"
put something on the map - "biror narsani xaritada ko'rsatish"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I have always found Geography to be a fascinating subject that opens up the world in ways I never imagined." - "Rostini aytsam, men doimo Geografiyani ajoyib fan deb bilganman, bu meni hech qachon tasavvur qilmagan tarzda dunyoni ochib beradi."

"From my perspective, Geography is an essential discipline that not only broadens one's understanding of the planet but also fosters a deeper appreciation for diverse cultures and environments." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, Geografiya nafaqat sayyora haqidagi tushunchani kengaytiradigan, balki turli madaniyatlar va muhitlarga chuqurroq ehtiromni rivojlantiradigan muhim fan hisoblanadi."

"I'd have to say that Geography is a subject that ignites my curiosity and provides endless opportunities for exploration and discovery." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, Geografiya mening qiziquvchanligimni qo'zg'atuvchi va kashfiyot uchun cheksiz imkoniyatlarni taqdim etuvchi fan."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Honestly, I have always had a profound fascination with Geography. There's something incredibly captivating about understanding the intricate interplay between humans and the environment. In fact, I picked up this interest during my school years when I had the opportunity to delve into various geographical phenomena. "The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page"; Geography, in a sense, allows us to travel without moving an inch.

Moreover, I find that it plays a crucial role in addressing global challenges such as climate change, urban development, and resource management. These issues are not just theoretical for me; they are problems that hit close to home. I figured out how vital geographical knowledge is when planning sustainable solutions for our future.

On a personal note, Geography has also enriched my travel experiences. Being aware of the cultural and physical landscapes allows me to let my hair down and immerse myself fully in new environments. To sum up, Geography is not just a subject for me; it's a gateway to understanding the world in a more profound and meaningful way.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, men har doim geografiyaga chuqur qiziqish bildirganman. Insonlar va atrof-muhit o'rtasidagi murakkab o'zaro ta'sirni tushunishda nihoyatda hayratlanarli bir narsa bor. Aslida, men bu qiziqishni maktab yillarida turli geografik hodisalarni o'rganish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lganimda orttirganman. "Dunyo - bu kitob, sayohat qilmaganlar esa faqat bir sahifani o'qiydi"; Geografiya, ma'lum ma'noda, bir qadam ham tashlamasdan sayohat qilish imkonini beradi.

Bundan tashqari, men uning iqlim o'zgarishi, shaharsozlik va resurslarni boshqarish kabi global muammolarni hal qilishda muhim rol o'ynashini angladim. Bu masalalar men uchun shunchaki nazariy emas; ular bizga yaqin bo'lgan muammolardir. Kelajagimiz uchun barqaror yechimlarni rejalashtirishda geografik bilimlar naqadar muhim ekanligini angladim.

Shaxsiy nuqtai nazardan, geografiya mening sayohat tajribamni ham boyitdi. Madaniy va jismoniy landshaftlardan xabardor bo'lish yangi muhitlarga to'liq sho'ng'ish va erkin dam olish imkonini beradi. Xulosa qilib aytganda, geografiya men uchun shunchaki fan emas; bu dunyoni yanada chuqur va mazmunli tarzda tushunish uchun yo'l.

questions.prompt: Do you think Geography is useful?
questions.sampleA2: Yes, I think geography is good. I learn about countries and cities. And I like to see the mountains and rivers. It is interesting because I want to travel.
questions.sampleB1: I think geography is quite useful. It helps you understand the world, like where countries are and what they are like. For example, you can learn about different climates and landscapes. Also, it can be helpful if you want to travel because you will know more about the places you visit.
questions.sampleB2: Yes, definitely. The thing is, geography helps you make sense of what's going on in the world — things like climate change, migration and how resources are shared out. I suppose it also broadens your horizons and makes you more aware of other cultures. So all in all, I'd say it's a really practical subject to have under your belt.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ha, menimcha geografiya yaxshi. Men davlatlar va shaharlar haqida o'rganaman. Va menga tog'lar va daryolarni ko'rish yoqadi. Bu qiziqarli, chunki men sayohat qilishni xohlayman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, geografiya juda foydali. U dunyoni tushunishingizga yordam beradi, masalan, davlatlar qayerda joylashgan va ular qanday ekanligini.
Misol uchun, siz turli iqlimlar va landshaftlar haqida bilib olishingiz mumkin. Shuningdek, agar siz sayohat qilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, bu foydali bo'lishi mumkin, chunki siz tashrif buyuradigan joylar haqida ko'proq bilasiz.
questions.uzSampleB2: Ha, men geografiya foydali fan deb hisoblayman. U aholi tarqalishi va resurslarni boshqarish kabi global muammolarni tushunish uchun asos yaratadi. Geografiyani o'rganish, shuningdek, odamlarning o'z muhiti bilan qanday o'zaro ta'sirlashuvini o'rganar ekan, turli madaniyatlar va jamiyatlar haqidagi tushunchamizni ham oshirishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, u sayyoramiz duch kelayotgan muammolar, masalan, iqlim o'zgarishi va urbanizatsiya haqida tanqidiy fikrlashni rag'batlantiradi. Shuning uchun, u yanada xabardor va mas'uliyatli global nuqtai nazarni rivojlantirish uchun foydalidir.

"From my perspective, Geography provides critical insights into the interconnectedness of natural and human systems." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, Geografiya tabiiy va insoniy tizimlarning o'zaro bog'liqligiga oid muhim tushunchalarni beradi."

"I'd have to say that Geography is a pivotal subject that equips individuals with the knowledge to address global challenges." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, Geografiya global muammolarni hal qilish uchun odamlarni bilim bilan ta'minlaydigan muhim mavzudir."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Absolutely, I genuinely believe that Geography is an immensely valuable subject. It not only helps us understand the physical landscapes of our planet but also the complex interactions between humans and their environments. One of the key benefits of studying Geography is that it provides insight into issues such as climate change, sustainability, and resource management. For instance, when I set off on my travels, I honestly find it fascinating to apply what I've learned, such as recognizing geographical features and understanding local climates.

Moreover, Geography plays a crucial role in broadening our horizons and fostering a global perspective. It's an interdisciplinary field that integrates elements of history, politics, and cultural studies. This multifaceted approach enriches our understanding of how global systems operate and how they come together to influence societies. As the saying goes, "knowledge is power", and Geography is undoubtedly a powerful tool to navigate the challenges of the modern world. In my opinion, it's not merely useful; it's essential for fostering informed and conscientious global citizens.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Albatta, men geografiya juda qimmatli fan ekanligiga chin dildan ishonaman. U nafaqat sayyoramizning fizik landshaftlarini, balki insonlar va ularning atrof-muhiti o'rtasidagi murakkab o'zaro ta'sirlarni ham tushunishga yordam beradi. Geografiyani o'rganishning asosiy afzalliklaridan biri shundaki, u iqlim o'zgarishi, barqarorlik va resurslarni boshqarish kabi masalalar haqida tushuncha beradi. Misol uchun, sayohatga chiqqanimda, geografik xususiyatlarni tanib olish va mahalliy iqlimni tushunish kabi o'rganganlarimni qo'llashni juda qiziqarli deb bilaman.

Bundan tashqari, geografiya dunyoqarashimizni kengaytirish va global nuqtai nazarni rivojlantirishda muhim rol o'ynaydi. Bu tarix, siyosat va madaniyatshunoslik elementlarini birlashtirgan fanlararo sohadir. Ushbu ko'p qirrali yondashuv global tizimlar qanday ishlashini va ularning jamiyatlarga qanday ta'sir qilishini tushunishimizni boyitadi. Aytganlaridek, "bilim - kuch", va geografiya, shubhasiz, zamonaviy dunyo muammolarini hal qilish uchun kuchli vositadir. Mening fikrimcha, u shunchaki foydali emas; u xabardor va vijdonli global fuqarolarni tarbiyalash uchun zarurdir.

questions.prompt: How often do you send text messages?
questions.sampleA1: I send text messages. Every day. To my friend.
questions.sampleA2: I send text messages every day. I send messages to my family and my friends. I like to text because it is easy. But sometimes I call my mom.
questions.sampleB1: I send text messages pretty often, I think. Maybe five or six times a day. I usually text my friends to make plans. Also, I text my family to see how they are. It's faster than calling, but sometimes calling is better.
questions.sampleB2: Honestly, I'm texting pretty much non-stop throughout the day. I'll fire off a quick message to my friends to sort out plans, or drop my mum a line just to check in. I suppose it's second nature by now. For me it's far handier than calling, especially when someone's tied up at work.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men SMS xabarlar yuboraman. Har kuni. O'rtog'imga.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men har kuni SMS xabarlar yuboraman. Men oilamga va do'stlarimga xabarlar yuboraman. Menga SMS yozish yoqadi, chunki bu oson. Lekin ba'zida men onamga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
questions.uzSampleB1: Men matnli xabarlarni juda tez-tez yuboraman, deb o'ylayman. Balki kuniga besh yoki olti marta. Odatda do'stlarimga reja tuzish uchun xabar yozaman. Shuningdek, oilamdagilarga ularning ahvoli qanday ekanligini bilish uchun xabar yozaman. Bu qo'ng'iroq qilishdan tezroq, lekin ba'zida qo'ng'iroq qilish yaxshiroq.
questions.uzSampleB2: Men SMS xabarlarini juda tez-tez yuboraman, ehtimol kuniga bir necha marta. Bu mening do'stlar va oila bilan muloqot qilishning asosiy usuli, ayniqsa tezkor yangiliklar yoki uchrashuvlarni tashkil qilish uchun. Menimcha, bu qo'ng'iroq qilishdan ko'ra ancha qulay, ayniqsa odamlar band bo'lganda. Biroq, chuqurroq suhbatlar uchun men hali ham telefon qo'ng'irog'ini afzal ko'raman. SMS yozish kundalik muloqot uchun juda samarali.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - How often do you send text messages?...
idioms: at the drop of a hat - "hech ikkilanmasdan"
"Stay in the loop" - "Yangiliklardan xabardor bo'lib turmoq"
on the same wavelength - "bir xil fikrda bo'lish"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I find myself frequently engaged in sending text messages throughout the day." - "Rostini aytsam, men kun davomida tez-tez matnli xabarlar yuborish bilan band bo'laman."
"From my perspective, texting has become an indispensable part of daily communication." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, matnli xabar yozish kundalik muloqotning ajralmas qismiga aylangan."
"I'd have to say that texting is a regular activity in my daily routine." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, matnli xabar yozish mening kundalik faoliyatimning odatiy qismidir."

questions.sampleAnswer: Well, I frequently send text messages, as it's become an integral part of my daily routine. I let my fingers do the talking almost every hour, whether it’s to check in with family or to coordinate with colleagues. Texting, I believe, offers a convenient and efficient way to communicate, especially when a phone call might be intrusive. Moreover, I especially appreciate how it allows for quick exchanges without the need for formality. Interestingly, while some people might find texting impersonal, I actually find it quite personal when you can add a touch of humor with emojis or gifs. In today's fast-paced world, texting is a lifeline to stay connected without having to carve out time for lengthy calls. As the saying goes, "A stitch in time saves nine," and texting saves me both time and effort.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Xo'sh, men tez-tez SMS xabarlar yuboraman, chunki bu mening kundalik hayotimning ajralmas qismiga aylangan. Men deyarli har soatda "qo'llarim bilan gaplashaman", xoh bu oilam bilan bog'lanish bo'lsin, xoh hamkasblarim bilan muvofiqlashish bo'lsin. SMS yozish, menimcha, muloqot qilishning qulay va samarali usulini taklif etadi, ayniqsa telefon qo'ng'irog'i xalaqit berishi mumkin bo'lgan hollarda. Bundan tashqari, menga ayniqsa uning rasmiyatchilikka hojat qoldirmasdan tezkor almashinuvlarga imkon berishi yoqadi. Qizig'i shundaki, ba'zi odamlar SMS yozishni shaxsiy emas deb hisoblashlari mumkin bo'lsa-da, men aslida emojilar yoki giflar bilan hazil qo'shish imkoniyati bo'lganda, uni juda shaxsiy deb bilaman. Bugungi tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanayotgan dunyoda SMS yozish - bu uzoq qo'ng'iroqlar uchun vaqt ajratmasdan aloqada bo'lishning hayotiy yo'lidir. Maqol aytganidek, "Vaqtida qilingan ish - bir balo qutqarar", SMS yozish esa menga ham vaqtni, ham kuchni tejaydi.

questions.prompt: Look at the pictures. What do you see in these pictures?
questions.sampleA2:
I see pictures of people eating.

In one picture, they are in a restaurant, and they look happy.

In the other picture, they are at home, and they are also happy.

They are eating food together.
questions.sampleB1:
In the pictures, I can see people eating together.

The first picture shows a group of friends in a restaurant, I think.

They are having a good time and the food looks delicious.

The second picture is a family eating at home.

They also look happy and it seems like they are enjoying their meal.

In my opinion, both pictures show the importance of sharing meals with people you like.
questions.sampleB2: Both of these pictures show people sharing a meal and enjoying each other's company. In the first image, we see a group of young adults or friends out for a meal in what looks like a bustling restaurant or pub. They're all smiling and laughing, clearly having a good time as they chat and eat. The atmosphere seems very social and lively. On the other hand, the second picture depicts a family – parents and their children – gathered around a table at home. They're also sharing a meal and bursting with laughter. While the first scene is more public and about friends, the second highlights the warmth of family bonding over food, perhaps a home-cooked meal.

questions.sampleAnswer:
When I look at these two images, I instantly notice the underlying theme of convivial dining experiences, though each offers a distinct atmosphere and setting.

In the first image, we see a lively group of four individuals enjoying a meal in what seems to be a cozy, yet vibrant restaurant. The robust brick walls and the generous sunlight pouring through the large windows set the stage for a warm ambiance. The earthy tones, predominantly browns and greens, contribute to this relaxed environment. Clearly, the table is adorned with an appetizing array of dishes, including salads, fries, and bowls of soup or stew, complemented by glasses of wine and beer. The individuals seem to be in high spirits, their expressions exuding joy and camaraderie. Their casual attire further signifies that this is a leisurely gathering among friends, allowing them to let their hair down and enjoy each other's company.

Meanwhile, the second image captures a joyful family gathering in a bright and modern home setting. The well-lit kitchen with its open shelves and expansive windows lends a fresh and airy feel to the scene. The soft whites and blues not only create a serene atmosphere but also enhance the warmth shared by the family. This photograph features five people: three adults and two children, all captured in a moment of shared laughter. The table, set with colorful dishes of food such as salad, rice, bread, and chicken, suggests a hearty home-cooked meal. Their casual, vibrant clothing and relaxed seating bring out the essence of a close-knit family gathering. The emotions displayed on their faces reflect genuine joy and togetherness, painting a picture of familial harmony.

Overall, both images encapsulate the joyful essence of shared meals, though in distinct settings. Whether among friends or family, the act of dining together "brings people closer" and creates lasting memories, a universal truth that resonates in both pictures.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men bu ikki suratga nazar tashlar ekanman, darhol mehmondo'stlik bilan ovqatlanish tajribalarining asosiy mavzusi e'tiborimni tortadi, garchi ularning har biri o'ziga xos muhit va sharoitni taklif qilsa ham.

Birinchi suratda biz to'rt kishidan iborat jonli guruhni ko'ramiz, ular qulay, ammo serharakat restoranda ovqatlanishmoqda. Mustahkam g'isht devorlari va katta derazalardan tushayotgan mo'l quyosh nurlari iliq muhit uchun zamin yaratadi. Yer ranglari, asosan jigarrang va yashil ranglar, bu xotirjam muhitga hissa qo'shadi. Aniqki, stol salatlar, kartoshka fri, sho'rva yoki dimlama idishlari, shuningdek, vino va pivo stakanlari bilan to'ldirilgan ishtahani ochuvchi taomlar bilan bezatilgan. Odamlar kayfiyatlari a'lo darajada ekanligi ko'rinib turibdi, ularning ifodalari quvonch va hamjihatlikni aks ettiradi. Ularning kundalik kiyimlari do'stlar davrasida dam olish uchun yig'ilish ekanligini yana bir bor tasdiqlaydi, bu ularga erkin dam olish va bir-birlarining suhbatidan zavqlanish imkonini beradi.

Ayni paytda, ikkinchi surat yorug' va zamonaviy uy sharoitida quvnoq oilaviy yig'ilishni aks ettiradi. Ochiq javonlar va keng derazalarga ega yaxshi yoritilgan oshxona sahnaga tetik va havodorlik baxsh etadi. Yumshoq oq va ko'k ranglar nafaqat xotirjam muhit yaratadi, balki oila a'zolari o'rtasidagi iliqlikni ham oshiradi. Ushbu fotosuratda besh kishi: uch nafar kattalar va ikki bola tasvirlangan, ularning barchasi umumiy kulgi lahzasida qo'lga olingan. Stol salat, guruch, non va tovuq kabi rang-barang taomlar bilan bezatilgan bo'lib, uyda tayyorlangan mazali taomdan dalolat beradi. Ularning kundalik, yorqin kiyimlari va qulay o'rindiqlari ahil oilaviy yig'ilish mohiyatini ochib beradi. Ularning yuzlarida aks etgan his-tuyg'ular chinakam quvonch va birlikni aks ettiradi, oilaviy uyg'unlik manzarasini yaratadi.

Umuman olganda, ikkala surat ham turli sharoitlarda bo'lsa ham, umumiy ovqatlanishning quvonchli mohiyatini o'zida mujassam etgan. Do'stlar davrasida bo'ladimi yoki oila davrasida, birgalikda ovqatlanish odamlarni yaqinlashtiradi va unutilmas xotiralar yaratadi, bu ikkala suratda ham aks etgan umumiy haqiqatdir.

questions.prompt: What are some of the advantages of eating in a restaurant?
questions.sampleA1: Food good. I like restaurant. No cook.
questions.sampleA2: I like restaurants. The food is good and I don't need to cook. But it is expensive, and sometimes it is busy.
questions.sampleB1: I think eating in a restaurant is good because you don't have to cook. Also, the food is usually very delicious, and you can try different kinds of food. However, it can be expensive sometimes, especially if you go to a fancy restaurant.
questions.sampleB2: Well, there are quite a few perks to eating out. For starters, you get a proper break from cooking and washing up, which is a treat after a busy week. On top of that, restaurants let you try all sorts of dishes you'd never whip up at home. And to be honest, it's a lovely way to catch up with friends over a nice meal.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ovqat yaxshi. Menga restoran yoqadi. Ovqat pishirmayman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga restoranlar yoqadi. Ovqat mazali va ovqat pishirishimga hojat yo'q. Lekin bu qimmat va ba'zan odam ko'p bo'ladi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Menimcha, restoranda ovqatlanish yaxshi, chunki ovqat pishirishingizga hojat yo'q. Qolaversa, ovqat odatda juda mazali bo'ladi va siz turli xil ovqatlarni tatib ko'rishingiz mumkin. Biroq, ba'zida qimmat bo'lishi mumkin, ayniqsa, agar hashamatli restoranga borsangiz.
questions.uzSampleB2: Restoranda ovqatlanishning, albatta, ba'zi afzalliklari bor. Birinchidan, bu ovqat pishirish va tozalashdan tanaffus beradi, bu esa haqiqiy vaqtni tejashga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, restoranlar uyda osonlikcha tayyorlay olmaydigan turli xil oshxonalar va taomlarni taklif etadi. Bundan tashqari, bu do'stlar yoki oila bilan muloqot qilish va vaqt o'tkazishning yaxshi usuli, garchi bu, albatta, muayyan restoranga va sizning davrangizga bog'liq.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - What are some of the advantages of eating in a res...
idioms: wine and dine - "yaxshi ovqatlanish va ichimlik ichish"
"The cherry on top" - "Eng zo'ri"
feast for the senses - "hissiyotlar uchun ziyofat"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I find dining in a restaurant to be a delightful experience that offers numerous benefits." - "Rostini aytsam, restoranda ovqatlanishni ko'plab foydalar taqdim etuvchi yoqimli tajriba deb bilaman."

"From my perspective, eating out is not just about nourishment, but also about social interaction and enjoyment." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, tashqarida ovqatlanish nafaqat oziqlanish, balki ijtimoiy muloqot va zavq olish haqida ham."

"I'd have to say that one of the primary advantages of dining in a restaurant is the exposure to diverse cuisines." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, restoranda ovqatlanishning asosiy afzalliklaridan biri turli xil oshxonalarga ta'sir qilishdir."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Eating in a restaurant undoubtedly offers a plethora of advantages that can add spice to one's life. Firstly, dining out gives people the chance to experience a social experience, allowing them to hang out with friends and family in a more relaxed setting than at home. It's incredibly common for people to bond over food, and restaurants provide the perfect backdrop for meaningful conversations. As the saying goes, "Good food is the foundation of genuine happiness".

Furthermore, dining in a restaurant offers the luxury of variety. With an array of cuisines and dishes at one's fingertips, individuals can step into new culinary worlds without the hassle of cooking. This particularly appeals to those who are adventurous with their palate or those who simply don't have the time or expertise to prepare complex dishes at home.

Moreover, eating out can be a wonderful opportunity to celebrate special occasions. Whether it's a birthday, an anniversary, or even a promotion, restaurants often provide the ambiance and service that elevate the celebration. Honestly, these establishments are adept at creating memorable experiences that people cherish for years.

From a practical perspective, dining in a restaurant also means that there’s no need to worry about the post-meal cleanup. After a sumptuous meal, all one needs to do is sit back and relax, leaving the chores to the staff. "Time and tide wait for no man", and by eating out, one can make the most of their time without the mundane task of washing up.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Restoranda ovqatlanish, shubhasiz, inson hayotiga zavq bag'ishlaydigan ko'plab afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Birinchidan, tashqarida ovqatlanish odamlarga uyga qaraganda ancha qulay muhitda do'stlar va oila bilan vaqt o'tkazish imkonini berib, ijtimoiy tajribaga ega bo'lish imkoniyatini beradi. Odamlarning ovqat ustida yaqinlashishi juda keng tarqalgan va restoranlar mazmunli suhbatlar uchun ajoyib sharoit yaratadi. Aytishlaricha, "Yaxshi ovqat - chinakam baxtning asosi".

Bundan tashqari, restoranda ovqatlanish xilma-xillik hashamatini taqdim etadi. Qo'l ostida turli xil oshxonalar va taomlar mavjudligi sababli, odamlar ovqat tayyorlash tashvishisiz yangi kulinar dunyoga qadam qo'yishlari mumkin. Bu, ayniqsa, ta'm sezgisi bilan sarguzasht izlayotganlar yoki shunchaki uyda murakkab taomlarni tayyorlash uchun vaqti yoki tajribasi yo'qlarga yoqadi.

Bundan tashqari, tashqarida ovqatlanish maxsus tadbirlarni nishonlash uchun ajoyib imkoniyat bo'lishi mumkin. Tug'ilgan kun, yubiley yoki hatto lavozimning ko'tarilishi bo'ladimi, restoranlar ko'pincha bayramni ko'taradigan muhit va xizmatni ta'minlaydi. Rostini aytsam, bu muassasalar odamlar yillar davomida qadrlaydigan unutilmas tajribalarni yaratishga mohir.

Amaliy nuqtai nazardan, restoranda ovqatlanish, shuningdek, ovqatdan keyingi tozalash haqida tashvishlanishga hojat yo'qligini anglatadi. Ajoyib ovqatdan so'ng, odamga kerak bo'lgan narsa - orqaga o'tirib dam olish, ishlarni xodimlarga topshirishdir. "Vaqt va suv hech kimni kutmaydi" va tashqarida ovqatlanish orqali odam idishlarni yuvish kabi zerikarli vazifasiz vaqtidan unumli foydalanishi mumkin.

questions.prompt: Why do some people prefer to eat at home?
questions.sampleA1: I like home. Food good. Cheap. Happy.
questions.sampleA2: I like to eat at home. It is good and I can cook what I want. It's cheaper than restaurants. And I can eat with my family, because it's nice.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think some people prefer eating at home because it's cheaper. Going to restaurants can be expensive. Also, at home, you know what's in your food, so it's probably healthier. For example, you can use less salt. It's also more comfortable eating at home with your family.
questions.sampleB2: I suppose a lot of people stick to eating at home mainly because it's easier on the wallet. On top of that, you're in charge of exactly what goes into your food, so it tends to be healthier. And the thing is, there's something really cosy about sitting down with your family in your own space, without the hustle and bustle of a packed restaurant.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men uyda bo'lishni yaxshi ko'raman. Ovqat yaxshi. Arzon. Xursandman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men uyda ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'raman. Bu yaxshi va men xohlagan narsamni pishirishim mumkin. Bu restoranlardan arzonroq. Va men oilam bilan ovqatlanishim mumkin, chunki bu yoqimli.
questions.uzSampleB1: Xo'sh, menimcha, ba'zi odamlar uyda ovqatlanishni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki bu arzonroq. Restoranlarga borish qimmat bo'lishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, uyda siz ovqatingizda nima borligini bilasiz, shuning uchun u sog'lomroq bo'lishi mumkin. Masalan, siz kamroq tuz ishlatishingiz mumkin. Uyda oilangiz bilan ovqatlanish ham qulayroq.
questions.uzSampleB2: Odamlarning uyda ovqatlanishni ko'proq afzal ko'rishlariga bir nechta sabab bor. Birinchidan, bu odatda tashqarida ovqatlanishga qaraganda ancha arzonroq. Mahsulotlarning narxi restoran taomining narxidan sezilarli darajada past. Ikkinchidan, odamlar ingredientlar va porsiya hajmini nazorat qila oladilar, bu esa sog'lom ovqatlanishni saqlashni osonlashtiradi. Uyda ovqatlanish, shuningdek, yanada xotirjam va samimiy muhitni taqdim etadi. Siz ovqatingizdan tinch va sokinlikda, gavjum restoranning chalg'ituvchi omillarisiz bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin. Bu, ayniqsa, uzoq va stressli kundan keyin juda yoqimli bo'lishi mumkin.

sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I find that dining at home offers a sense of comfort and personalization that is hard to replicate elsewhere." - "Rostini aytsam, uyda ovqatlanish boshqa joylarda takrorlanishi qiyin bo'lgan qulaylik va shaxsiylashtirish hissini beradi."

"From my perspective, home-cooked meals often provide a healthier and more balanced diet." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, uyda tayyorlangan taomlar ko'pincha sog'lomroq va muvozanatliroq parhezni taqdim etadi."

"I'd have to say that the ability to control ingredients and cooking methods makes eating at home appealing for many." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, ingredientlar va pishirish usullarini nazorat qilish qobiliyati ko'pchilik uchun uyda ovqatlanishni jozibador qiladi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
There are several reasons why people choose to eat at home rather than dining out. First and foremost, eating at home is undoubtedly more economical. When you cook your own meals, you have the freedom to purchase ingredients from local markets, which can substantially reduce costs compared to restaurants. Moreover, home-cooked meals offer a health benefit as well. People have complete control over the ingredients and cooking methods, allowing them to avoid preservatives and excessive fats that are often present in restaurant dishes.

Additionally, eating at home can also be a social experience where families and friends gather to enjoy one another's company. This lets you let your hair down and bond with loved ones without the distractions of a bustling restaurant environment. For instance, when I was growing up, our family dinners were occasions for storytelling and laughter, something that could hardly be replicated in a public setting.

Lastly, there's a sense of accomplishment and personal satisfaction in preparing a meal yourself. It can bring out creativity and culinary skills, making it an enriching and fulfilling activity. As the "old saying goes", "the way to a person's heart is through their stomach", which perfectly encapsulates the reward of cooking at home.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Odamlarning tashqarida ovqatlanishdan ko'ra uyda ovqatlanishni afzal ko'rishlarining bir nechta sabablari bor. Birinchi va eng muhimi, uyda ovqatlanish, shubhasiz, tejamkorroqdir. O'z taomlaringizni tayyorlaganingizda, mahalliy bozorlardan mahsulotlar sotib olish erkinligiga ega bo'lasiz, bu esa restoranlarga nisbatan xarajatlarni sezilarli darajada kamaytirishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, uyda tayyorlangan taomlar sog'liq uchun ham foydali. Odamlar ingredientlar va pishirish usullari ustidan to'liq nazoratga ega bo'lib, restoran taomlarida ko'p uchraydigan konservantlar va ortiqcha yog'lardan qochish imkonini beradi.

Bundan tashqari, uyda ovqatlanish oilalar va do'stlar bir-birining suhbatidan bahramand bo'lish uchun yig'iladigan ijtimoiy tajriba ham bo'lishi mumkin. Bu sizga dam olishga va gavjum restoran muhitining chalg'ituvchi omillarisiz yaqinlaringiz bilan bog'lanishga imkon beradi. Misol uchun, men o'sib ulg'ayganimda, oilaviy kechki ovqatlarimiz hikoyalar aytish va kulgi uchun imkoniyat edi, buni jamoat joyida deyarli takrorlab bo'lmaydi.

Nihoyat, ovqatni o'zingiz tayyorlashda yutuq va shaxsiy qoniqish hissi bor. Bu ijodkorlikni va pazandalik mahoratini namoyon qilishi, uni boyituvchi va qoniqarli faoliyatga aylantirishi mumkin. "Eski maqolda aytilganidek", "insonning qalbiga yo'l oshqozon orqali o'tadi", bu uyda ovqat pishirishning mukofotini mukammal tarzda ifodalaydi.

questions.prompt: Describe a new skill you would like to learn
questions.sampleA1: I want learn swim. I like water. Swim is good.
questions.sampleA2: I want to learn to cook. I can make pasta, but I want to cook better food. My mother cooks very well and I want to be like her. It is difficult, but I will try.
questions.sampleB1: A new skill I'd like to learn is coding. I think it's very useful these days. Computers are everywhere, and knowing how to code would be a big advantage. For example, I could make my own website. However, it seems quite difficult, so I would need to take a course.
questions.sampleB2: A skill I'd absolutely love to get to grips with is playing the guitar. I've been meaning to pick it up for years now, but somehow life has always got in the way. To be honest, the main reason it appeals to me is that I've always been a bit of a music lover, and there's something magical about making music yourself rather than just listening to it. I can just picture myself sitting around with friends at a barbecue, strumming a few songs while everyone joins in — that would be a dream come true. I suppose I'd start off by finding a decent teacher or, more realistically, following some online tutorials, since they're free and you can learn at your own pace. I know full well it won't happen overnight; your fingers really ache at first and it takes ages to build up the muscle memory. But I'm prepared to knuckle down and practise a little every day. What draws me to it most is that it's a skill you can carry with you for life. Unlike a lot of things you cram for and then forget, music sticks with you. On top of that, I've read that playing an instrument is brilliant for relieving stress and keeping your brain sharp, so it would kill two birds with one stone. All in all, if I could master just one new skill, learning the guitar would be right at the top of my list, and hopefully I'll finally take the plunge this year.

Men o'rganmoqchi bo'lgan yangi ko'nikma bu dasturlash. Menimcha, bu hozirgi kunda juda foydali. Kompyuterlar hamma joyda va qanday qilib dasturlashni bilish katta afzallik bo'lardi.

Men o'rganishni juda istagan yangi ko'nikmalardan biri bu grafik dizayn bo'yicha mahoratga ega bo'lishdir. Bugungi raqamli asrda vizual kommunikatsiya juda muhim va menimcha, grafik dizaynda mohir bo'lish g'oyalarni samarali yetkazish qobiliyatimni sezilarli darajada oshiradi. Bundan tashqari, bu men juda foydali deb biladigan ijodiy yo'nalishdir.

Grafik dizaynni o'rganish uchun men, ehtimol, onlayn darsliklar va Adobe Photoshop yoki Illustrator kabi dasturlardan boshlayman. Shuningdek, o'z ko'nikmalarimni takomillashtirish va kuchli portfel yaratish uchun tajribali dizaynerlardan fikr-mulohazalar so'rayman.

What it is and why you need it?
What you should do to learn it?
questions.sampleAnswer:
One new skill I would dearly love to learn is playing the piano. Music has always been a profound passion of mine, and the piano, in particular, seems to offer an endless sea of opportunities for creative expression. I believe that mastering this instrument would not only allow me to pick up a new hobby but also enrich my social experiences by being able to perform at gatherings and connect with other musicians.

Moreover, I feel it is a skill that could help me de-stress after a long day. As the saying goes, "music is a universal language", and I am certain that learning the piano would provide me with a creative outlet and a sense of accomplishment.

To learn this skill, I would first need to invest in a good quality keyboard or even a piano, if space permits. Enrolling in professional music lessons would be essential to ensure that I am learning the correct techniques. Besides, I would dedicate a specific time each day to practice, as consistency is key when acquiring any new skill.

Furthermore, I would make use of online resources such as tutorials and interactive courses, which offer a modern approach to learning. Joining a local music club or online forums could also be beneficial, as it would allow me to interact with fellow enthusiasts and gain insights from their experiences.

Overall, I am genuinely excited about the prospect of learning to play the piano, as I am confident it will bring a sense of fulfillment and joy to my life. As they say, "practice makes perfect", and I am ready to embark on this musical journey.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men o'rganishni juda istaydigan yangi mahorat bu pianino chalishdir. Musiqa doim men uchun katta ishtiyoq bo'lib kelgan va ayniqsa, pianino ijodiy ifoda uchun cheksiz imkoniyatlar dengizini taklif etadigandek tuyuladi. Ishonamanki, bu asbobni o'zlashtirish nafaqat yangi mashg'ulot orttirishimga yordam beradi, balki yig'inlarda chiqish qilish va boshqa musiqachilar bilan aloqa o'rnatish orqali ijtimoiy tajribamni ham boyitadi.

Bundan tashqari, bu uzoq kundan keyin stressdan xalos bo'lishimga yordam beradigan mahorat deb o'ylayman. Aytishlaricha, "musiqa - bu umumjahon tilidir" va aminmanki, pianino o'rganish menga ijodiy erkinlik va muvaffaqiyat hissini beradi.

Bu mahoratni o'rganish uchun avvalo sifatli klaviatura yoki hatto imkoniyat bo'lsa, pianinoga sarmoya kiritishim kerak bo'ladi. To'g'ri texnikalarni o'rganayotganimga ishonch hosil qilish uchun professional musiqa darslariga yozilish muhim bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, har qanday yangi mahoratni egallashda izchillik muhimligi sababli, har kuni mashq qilish uchun ma'lum vaqt ajrataman.

Bundan tashqari, o'rganishga zamonaviy yondashuvni taklif qiluvchi darsliklar va interaktiv kurslar kabi onlayn resurslardan foydalanaman. Mahalliy musiqa klubiga yoki onlayn forumlarga qo'shilish ham foydali bo'lishi mumkin, chunki bu menga boshqa ishqibozlar bilan muloqot qilish va ularning tajribalaridan saboq olish imkonini beradi.

Umuman olganda, pianino chalishni o'rganish istiqboli meni chin dildan hayajonga solmoqda, chunki bu hayotimga qoniqish va quvonch hissini olib kelishiga aminman. Aytishlaricha, "mashq mukammallikka olib keladi" va men bu musiqiy sayohatga chiqishga tayyorman.

questions.prompt: Extracurricular activities should be taught at school
questions.sampleA2:
I think it is good.

Because it is fun and we can play.

But maybe it is too much work.
questions.sampleB1:
I think extracurricular activities are a good idea for schools.

For example, sports and clubs are fun and help students relax.

However, some students might not want to do them, and they might prefer to study.

So, I think it should be optional.
questions.sampleB2: This is a really interesting topic, and I can honestly see both sides of the argument. On the one hand, there's a strong case for building extracurricular activities into the school timetable. The thing is, not every family can afford to pay for private clubs or lessons, so offering things like sport, drama and music at school helps to level the playing field. It also gives students a chance to discover hidden talents they'd never stumble across in an ordinary lesson, and it teaches valuable life skills like teamwork and leadership. On top of that, activities like these make school far more enjoyable, which keeps kids motivated. On the other hand, I suppose some people would argue that schools are already stretched pretty thin. Teachers are run off their feet as it is, and cramming even more into the day could pile on the pressure and leave less time for core subjects. There's also the worry that once something becomes compulsory, it loses its appeal — half the fun of a hobby is choosing it yourself. As for where I stand, I firmly believe schools should offer a wide range of extracurriculars, but they ought to keep them optional rather than forcing everyone to take part. That way, students who are keen can throw themselves into it, while those who'd rather focus on their studies aren't held back. At the end of the day, it's all about striking the right balance between a well-rounded education and not overloading young people.

questions.sampleAnswer: "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy," and this saying truly encapsulates the essence of integrating extracurricular activities into school curricula. While some argue that schools are already overburdened with packed schedules, I firmly believe that introducing activities like gardening can offer immense benefits to students. To begin with, spending time in a garden can be incredibly relaxing for pupils, providing a much-needed escape from academic pressures. This, in turn, can enhance their overall well-being and mental health. Moreover, students can pick up valuable skills such as planting and growing food. Such hands-on experiences foster a deeper understanding and appreciation for the natural world, which is becoming increasingly vital in our modern society where environmental challenges are rampant. On the flip side, it's undeniable that not all schools have the luxury of suitable outdoor space for a garden. This logistical limitation might hinder the implementation of such activities. Additionally, while some students might find gardening incredibly engaging, others may not share the same enthusiasm. The "one-size-fits-all" approach may not work, as individual interests vary significantly. Nevertheless, I would argue that schools can figure out innovative ways to incorporate gardening into their programs. Perhaps they could collaborate with local community gardens or use indoor planting kits in the classroom. Furthermore, even if not every student is enthralled by gardening, the exposure to such diverse activities can broaden their horizons and spark interest in something new. In conclusion, while the challenges of integrating extracurricular activities like gardening into school schedules are palpable, the benefits certainly outweigh the drawbacks. "Variety is the spice of life," and schools should endeavor to provide a holistic education that encompasses both academic and practical life skills.

Avvalo, bog'da vaqt o'tkazish o'quvchilar uchun
g'oyatda dam beruvchi bo'lishi mumkin, bu esa ularga akademik bosimdan zarur bo'lgan qochish imkoniyatini beradi. Bu, o'z navbatida, ularning umumiy
farovonligini va ruhiy salomatligini yaxshilashi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, o'quvchilar o'simlik ekish va oziq-ovqat yetishtirish kabi qimmatli ko'nikmalarni
o'rganishlari mumkin. Bunday amaliy tajribalar tabiat olamiga nisbatan chuqurroq tushuncha va minnatdorchilikni uyg'otadi, bu esa
zamonaviy jamiyatimizda atrof-muhit muammolari avj olayotgan bir paytda tobora muhim ahamiyat kasb etmoqda.

Boshqa tomondan, barcha maktablarda bog' uchun mos tashqi maydonning mavjudligi
inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Bu logistik cheklov bunday tadbirlarni amalga oshirishga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ba'zi o'quvchilar bog'dorchilikni
g'oyat qiziqarli deb topsalar, boshqalarida bunday ishtiyoq bo'lmasligi mumkin.
"Hamma uchun bir xil" yondashuvi ish bermasligi mumkin, chunki individual qiziqishlar sezilarli darajada farq qiladi.

Shunga qaramay, men maktablar bog'dorchilikni o'z dasturlariga kiritishning innovatsion usullarini
o'ylab topishlari mumkin deb ta'kidlayman. Ehtimol, ular mahalliy jamoat bog'lari bilan hamkorlik qilishlari yoki sinfda yopiq ekish to'plamlaridan foydalanishlari mumkin. Bundan tashqari, har bir o'quvchi bog'dorchilikka
qiziqmasa ham, bunday xilma-xil mashg'ulotlar bilan tanishish ularning
dunyosini kengaytirishi va nimagadir yangi qiziqish
uyg'otishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, bog'dorchilik kabi sinfdan tashqari mashg'ulotlarni maktab jadvaliga kiritishdagi qiyinchiliklar sezilarli bo'lsa-da, afzalliklari kamchiliklardan
albatta ustundir.
"Hayotning mazasi xilma-xillikda," va maktablar ham akademik, ham amaliy hayotiy ko'nikmalarni o'z ichiga olgan yaxlit ta'lim berishga intilishlari kerak.
